id: Attended Innovation and entrepreneurship training at South Eastern Kenya University By ICTA Kenya
title: Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training
summary: An interactive session on entrepreneurship and innovation as part of the Whitebox County Innovation Training 2026.
content:
A great learning experience yesterday at South Eastern Kenya University.
Thanks to ICT Authority (ICTA Kenya) for the interactive session on entrepreneurship and innovation as part of the Whitebox County Innovation Training 2026.
It was a valuable opportunity to learn more about developing ideas, identifying opportunities, building solutions, and nurturing the next generation of entrepreneurs and innovators.
It was also a great opportunity to connect, learn, and exchange ideas with other aspiring innovators.

Looking forward to applying these lessons and continuing to turn ideas into solutions that create real impact.
